does: Gives the average damage a character deals, as the AI estimates it, memoised per entity in the helper's map at +0x3D0 and computed by code:esv::AiHelpers::GetAverageDamageForCharacterNoCache on first use.

evidence.says: hash lookup by entity in the table at +0x3CC/+0x3D0; on a miss calls code:esv::AiHelpers::GetAverageDamageForCharacterNoCache and inserts the float

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 7 places, most of the calls from one position scorer the registry does not name: it ran in a fight, which does not show what it does
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
